summary: Core M1+M2 functionality, tests, live pi load, and no-persistence all pass, but 3 major issues found: quadratic over-cap eviction in word store (13s stall), phrase-layer restore 20x over budget with CI gates measuring only the phrase-less config, and rapid Tab-Tab within the 100ms display-debounce window returning stale-prefix sets that corrupt the input buffer; plus 2 minor (README overstates chain-arming path, .gitignore typo).
